The '''''Javelin''''' was a [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnought]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its short-lived successor, the [[Dark Empire]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="date" /> the ''Javelin'' was one of three ''Vengence''-class [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that participated in the Dark Empire's [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|invasion]] of the poorly defended [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Although the Imperial assault was initially successful, Imperial forces quickly began to turn on one another in a mad frenzy known as the [[Imperial Civil War|Imperial Mutiny]]. As part of that conflict, the ''Javelin'' was destroyed when its [[Unidentified captain (Javelin)|captain]] [[Ramming/Legends|rammed]] it into a [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Chasin)|Torpedo Sphere]] that guarded<ref name="TEGtW" /> the [[Chasin system/Legends|Chasin system]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> astronomical object [[Chasin]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Javelin'' was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
